- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum has hosted big names in music and has undergone a stunning renovation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum is known for its exceptional sound quality and electric atmosphere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Forum offers multiple bars, restaurants, and concession stands.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for attending a concert at The Forum include:
  - Arrive early to soak in the atmosphere.
  - Be prepared for security checks.
  - Use mobile-only ticketing.
  - Consider public transportation or ride-sharing due to parking challenges.
